0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3) host the Utah Jazz (1-8) in their 11th game of the season, with Minnesota sitting 3rd in the Northwest, half a game back, and 6th in the West while winning three straight. Utah is 5th in the Northwest, 6 games back, and 14th in the West after losing seven straight. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery; averaging 33.3 points in 33.7 minutes this season), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), Joan Beringer (fracture), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, 2026.
